recrop_geometry.dead_space_infeasibility_proof: The two-line punch renders at a fixed 186px in the banner zone, so the top 416px of the 1080 output is reserved for text + the 10px clearance and the subject gets 664px of height.  The pair silhouette is ~0.84 aspect, so at full available height it can never exceed ~558px = 29% of 1920 width; <=30% dead side margins would require the pair to occupy >=70% of the width.  Reaching that needs a head-and-shoulders crop (bottom cut y~=480), which destroys the 公主抱 pose.  Swept the whole feasible envelope y1 in [560,770]: best achievable dead margin is 53.2% (at y1=560, which cuts above the thigh); y1>=770 is infeasible outright because it needs x1>1920 with x0>=784.  Achieved 54.0%, down from 66.5%.
